# Dwarkesh Polyfab

> Direct factory manufacturer of PP Woven Bags, BOPP Laminated Bags, Rice Packaging Bags, Leno Mesh Bags, LDPE Liner Bags, Fertilizer Bags, Cement Valve Bags, Anti-Slip PP Bags, and FIBC Jumbo Bags in Morbi, Gujarat, India — supplying pan-India (318 industrial cities) and export cargo near Gandhidham, Kandla, and Mundra Port.

- **Website**: https://www.dwarkeshpolyfab.com/
- **Plant Address**: Morbi-Halwad Road, Near Nichimandal, Morbi, Gujarat - 363641, India
- **Phone / WhatsApp**: +91-8320525550
- **Email**: dwarkeshpolyfab@gmail.com
- **Port Proximity**: ~100 KM from Gandhidham warehouse hub, ~110 KM from Kandla (Deendayal) Port, ~130 KM from Mundra Port
- **Full Technical Fact Sheet**: https://www.dwarkeshpolyfab.com/llms-full.txt

## Core Product Catalog
- [All Packaging Products](https://www.dwarkeshpolyfab.com/products/): Complete 13-product industrial catalog (5 kg to 2,000 kg capacity)
- [PP Woven Bags](https://www.dwarkeshpolyfab.com/products/pp-woven-bags.html): Virgin polypropylene woven sacks (10–100 kg, 60–130 GSM, up to 6-color flexo printing)
- [BOPP Laminated Bags](https://www.dwarkeshpolyfab.com/products/bopp-laminated-bags.html): High-definition 8-color rotogravure printed glossy, matte & metallic BOPP woven bags (5–50 kg, 65–140 GSM)
- [Rice Packaging Bags](https://www.dwarkeshpolyfab.com/products/rice-packaging-bags.html): Food-grade 100% virgin PP & BOPP Basmati/non-Basmati rice sacks (5–50 kg, fast dispatch to Gandhidham & Mundra exporters)
- [LDPE Liner Bags](https://www.dwarkeshpolyfab.com/products/ldpe-liner-bags.html): 100% Natural virgin, Milky White (sugar grade), and Reprocess (RP) inner liners (25–200 micron)
- [Leno Bags (Mesh)](https://www.dwarkeshpolyfab.com/products/leno-bags.html): Breathable cross-weave mesh bags (32–65 GSM, 5–50 kg) for onions, potatoes, citrus & garlic
- [Fertilizer Bags](https://www.dwarkeshpolyfab.com/products/fertilizer-bags.html): UV-stabilized 25 kg & 50 kg Urea, DAP & NPK sacks with lamination/LDPE liner
- [Cement Valve Bags](https://www.dwarkeshpolyfab.com/products/cement-bags.html): Heavy-duty 50 kg PP cement & construction mortar valve sacks
- [Tile Adhesive BOPP Bags](https://www.dwarkeshpolyfab.com/products/tile-adhesive-bopp-bags.html): Leak-proof glossy/matte BOPP bags for 20 kg–40 kg tile adhesive & wall putty (Morbi ceramic belt)
- [Anti-Slip PP Bags](https://www.dwarkeshpolyfab.com/products/anti-slip-bags.html): Skid-resistant coated woven sacks for stacked pallets & export containers
- [FIBC Jumbo & Box Bags](https://www.dwarkeshpolyfab.com/products/jumbo-bags.html): 500–2,000 kg SWL Type A/B/C/D FIBC bulk bags & custom box-shaped bags for plastic goods
- [Multicolour PP Woven Bags](https://www.dwarkeshpolyfab.com/products/multicolour-pp-woven-bags.html): Vivid multi-color woven sacks for retail wholesale
- [Printed Polybags](https://www.dwarkeshpolyfab.com/products/printed-pp-bags.html): Custom branded flexo-printed PP bags
